name: PalPanelServerMods
description: Server-only Community-Raid build with compact 4000-unit authoritative arena and a 32-character crowd at radius 4500. Crowd grounding now uses floor-only capsule collision: WorldStatic/Terrain is blocked so NPCs stand normally, while all other collision channels, mesh/body-part hitboxes, damage, capture, locomotion and combat AI are disabled. CharacterMovement remains active for native floor/gravity handling. Previous Z pinning/teleport grounding is removed. No client installation required.
